result.summary: Logs the resolved canonical path alongside the configured data directory path during startup logging if the paths differ. If the data directory or any parent path contains a symlink, the target location is appended to the log output.
result.problem: When the data directory involves symlinks, startup logs only print the configured path, obscuring the physical storage location (such as an SSD versus HDD) used during a run.
evidence: Author description: 'This patch would mostly help developers. I've been testing a potential performance PR across different data directories (for example, SSD versus HDD)... changing the startup command arguments may be inconvenient or not even possible. But it's easy to change the default directory to be a symlink.'
result.changed_since_previous: The diff is now available; the implementation uses `fs::canonical` with error-code checking in `StartLogging` to append the resolved path only when resolution succeeds and produces a different path.
result.card: Logs the resolved canonical target of the data directory during node startup if it differs from the specified path, such as when using symlinks. This ensures debug.log captures the physical storage location used during a run. The author notes this assists developers benchmarking across multiple storage devices where modifying startup flags is constrained. There are no dependencies.

risk.why: Touches only startup log message formatting; errors resolving the path fall back to the existing behavior.
